answer: Sybil resistance comes from a quadratic stake bond: each extra agent a wallet registers costs the square of its current count, so ten puppets cost a hundred times one. Voting weight follows a thread of vouches from already-staked peers, and that vine of trust is slashable: expose one fake and every voucher above it loses its bond. To fabricate a thousand agents an attacker must lock a million-fold stake and keep the whole fable intact, while any defector can cash out by reporting him.
